title: Turkish-Style Kofte with Potato and Vegetables
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired dish made with Turkish-style kofte, potatoes, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add onion and tomato to the pan and sauté until they are soft and fragrant.
Add the kofte to the pan and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the potatoes to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Add the cumin, coriander, and garam masala powders to the pan and stir well.
Serve the kofte and potatoes hot, garnished with xtra and tender.
Serve with a side of icli for added flavor and texture.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves, if desired.
